methods.name: Blow-Off First Flush
methods.description: A completed daily blow-off setup arms the method. The first 4H capitulation after the peak must show an unusually violent RSI reset.
methods.trigger_summary: Completed daily breakout regime → next-day arm → first ≥8% 4H flush → RSI drops ≥18.174% in one bar and RSI acceleration ≤ -11.7202.

methods.name: Lower-High Second Dump
methods.description: A 4H downtrend produces a relief pump that fails well below the prior swing high, then a second selloff reaches oversold RSI.
methods.trigger_summary: 4H downtrend → relief pump ≥21.337% → lower high ≥19.915% below prior swing high → second dump ≥10% → RSI ≤30.

methods.name: Volume Capitulation Flush
methods.description: A first ≥8% post-breakout flush closes near the bottom of its 4H range on abnormal volume.
methods.trigger_summary: Completed daily breakout regime → next-day arm → first ≥8% 4H flush → close in bottom 15.27% of candle range → 4H volume ≥1.8296× its 20-bar median.

methods.name: Volume Capitulation + Funding
methods.description: C3 volume capitulation setup with a positive funding-state filter at the trigger.
methods.trigger_summary: C3 Volume Capitulation Flush qualifies → last published Hyperliquid funding rate at/before trigger ≥0.0013%.

params.funding_source: last published funding rate at or before trigger
